$comment: Image manifest. The single source of truth for the CI build matrix in .github/workflows/build.yml and for scripts/build.sh. See CONTRIBUTING.md on how to add an image.

frankenphp.$comment: targets maps a Dockerfile stage to a tag suffix. The field is optional: without it the whole Dockerfile is built and the tag equals the version. Key order matters: merge jobs run serially in this order and GHCR marks the last published version as Latest, so the primary tag goes last.
